title: Rules.
bodyText: The department may adopt rules pursuant to chapter 91 necessary to carry out the purposes of this chapter.
bodyHtml: §195D-6  Rules.  The department may adopt rules pursuant to chapter 91 necessary to carry out the purposes of this chapter. [L 1975, c 65, pt of §1; am L 1983, c 111, §7; am L 1997, c 380, §6]
